name: PARATHYROID HORMONE
description: PTH measures parathyroid gland function and evaluates calcium metabolism disorders. This test diagnoses hyperparathyroidism, hypoparathyroidism, and vitamin D disorders affecting calcium homeostasis.

testdetails.instrumentation: Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Coulter

literatureReview: PTH (Parathyroid Hormone) regulates calcium and phosphorus metabolism through actions on bone, kidney, and intestine. Normal range is 10-65 pg/mL. Elevated PTH with high calcium suggests primary hyperparathyroidism. Elevated PTH with low calcium suggests secondary hyperparathyroidism (vitamin D deficiency, renal failure). Low PTH with low calcium indicates hypoparathyroidism. Chemiluminescent immunoassay measures intact PTH (1-84). Samples must be handled carefully to prevent degradation. PTH has pulsatile secretion, so single measurements may vary. Used with calcium, phosphorus, and vitamin D for comprehensive evaluation of mineral metabolism. Critical for diagnosing parathyroid disorders and monitoring treatment response.
